dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts federal financial regulatory agencies and their Inspectors General, as well as insured depository institutions submitting mergers.
dimensions.evidence: the Inspector General of each Federal depository institution regulatory agency shall review the Federal depository institution regulatory agency's merger review procedures

dimensions.assessment: Administrative and procedural oversight requirement rather than a change to merger laws themselves.
dimensions.evidence: examine that regulator's merger approval procedures, including timeliness and efficiency, and report on its findings and recommendations

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state specific federal spending or revenue changes.
Mandates recurring reviews, public reports, and agency implementation plans regarding depository institution merger applications.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a review every 3 years of the regulator's handling of insured depository institution merger applications

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent recurring review cycle every three years for federal financial regulators.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, and every 3 years thereafter

missing_information: Estimated administrative costs for conducting the Inspector General reviews
Specific operational changes regulators might adopt based on recommendations
importance_detail.rationale: Requires Offices of Inspector General for federal financial regulators to conduct periodic reviews every three years of bank and credit union merger application procedures.
